paper: A Dynamic Points Removal Benchmark in Point Cloud Maps (ITSC 2023)
recorded_with: reproduce.py: dataset integrity + dual-implementation eval cross-check (3M sampled GT points)
note: Reproduces the measurement, not a score: the sequence, the GT label set, the evaluation rule (implemented twice) and the ranking of the four methods that depend on this folder. SA/AA are copied from each method's own score json.

metric_groups.plain_keys: the benchmark's own ROS-free ports - this folder's original subject
metric_groups.Removert_official_*: the authors' own irapkaist/removert run, scored on the same KITTI 00 GT; kept separate because it is a different measurement (see 01-04). ERASOR's port is faithful in its own metric, Removert's is not - so the port's authority has to be checked per method.
